category_title: Grade 6 student with behavioral exceptionalities and migration-related learning difficulties
scenario_title: Independent writing task in the regular classroom
minimal_context: Dwayne is assigned to work on his own at a computer in the regular classroom to write paragraphs.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Dwayne, it is time to work on your own. Please sit down at the computer and do those paragraphs.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What do you think you should type first?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stands up from the computer and starts walking around the classroom) I can't work on my own.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Dwayne, sit down, try to do this.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Suddenly loses his temper and becomes threatening) No! I'm not doing it! (Starts pacing all over the place and refuses to work)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Dwayne, it is time to work on your own. Please sit down at the computer and do those paragraphs.

STUDENT: Okay, I'll do it.

TUTOR: What do you think you should type first?

STUDENT: (Stands up from the computer and starts walking around the classroom) I can't work on my own.

TUTOR: Dwayne, sit down, try to do this.

STUDENT: (Suddenly loses his temper and becomes threatening) No! I'm not doing it! (Starts pacing all over the place and refuses to work)

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: If I say, 'Dwayne sit down, try to do this'
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: he'll be all over the place. He cannot work.

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: thrown desks and been quite threatening
behavior_patterns.internal_state: he will be sweet one minute and then the next minute he loses it
